content: Hello, I am Lattice Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking.
First, I need to ask you two security questions. What is your postcode?
What is your year of birth?

I am calling about overdue payments on your account. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Your personal loan has 600.00 past due and is 4 days late. Your car loan has 450.00 past due and is 4 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amounts on all of these products today?
No, I won't pay the card, today or on any later date you offer. The personal loan arrears were paid yesterday, and the car loan isn't mine.
I have noted that. Could you pay 600.00 for the personal loan on Thursday 15 October 2026?
No, I already paid the personal loan arrears yesterday, so there's nothing more to pay on that.
Thank you for letting me know. A payment may take two business days to post. Could you pay 450.00 for the car loan on Thursday 15 October 2026?
No, that car loan isn't mine, so I won't be making any payment on it.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
